title: Nutty Gooey Indian Shrimp Korma
description: A rich and creamy Indian-inspired dish featuring shrimp, rigatoni, and a blend of spices, perfect for a special occasion. This pescatarian-friendly recipe combines the flavors of Mangalorean cuisine with a char-grilled twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat and char-grill the shrimp until pink and cooked through.
In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, then add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the garam masala, coriander, and cumin, and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped nuts and cook for an additional minute, until well combined.
Add the cooked rigatoni to the skillet and toss with the sauce until well coated.
Add the char-grilled shrimp to the skillet and toss with the rigatoni and sauce until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
